status: PROPOSED. A view over records that already exist; it adds no authority and replaces no Praxis, Ordo or progress-event contract. A handoff that disagrees with the records is wrong, not the records.
purpose: One message from an implementation lane to the integration coordinator per ready slice, so integration does not re-read requirements the lane already interpreted.

workItem.source: Praxis work item id (scope manifest workItems[].id)

requirements.source: the slice's requirements (never more than the manifest gives it)

commit.source: the branch head; the same value as the progress event implementation-completed.commit (RC/Progress.fs)

filesChanged.source: git diff --name-only main...commit; each must be owned by the lane or carry an owner-approved contribution PR

testsExecuted.source: Level 1/2 runs (change-impact.fsx select output) with their exit codes; informational only

results.source: per test project/suite: passed, failed, skipped counts

blockers.source: open owner decisions, change requests, failing tests

integrationReady.rule: true only if filesChanged are all owned or approved, Level 1/2 passed, and no blocker is open. It requests the governed gate; it never replaces it.

neverMeans: integrationReady=true is not verification; the governed gate (Level 3) decides.
testsExecuted is builder-authored evidence and never independent acceptance (AGENTS.md).
